gloss: laughing through tears; mixed tears and laughter

definitions.gloss: laughing through tears; mixed tears and laughter
definitions.explanation: the state of simultaneously crying and laughing, often from overwhelming emotion

examples.japanese: ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{泣|な}き{笑|わら}いになった。
examples.english: I was so moved that I started laughing and crying at the same time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んで→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧{泣|な}き{笑|わら}い⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We laughed and cried with joy at our reunion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{泣|な}き{笑|わら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: With tears and laughter mixed on her face, she said "thank you."

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ (to cry) + ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧ (laughter)

USAGE:
This expression describes an emotionally complex moment when joy and sadness (or relief) mix together. Common during:
- Reunions
- Weddings
- Graduations
- Receiving unexpected good news

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {泣|な}き{笑|わら}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to laugh and cry at the same time
- {泣|な}き{笑|わら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ - a face with tears and laughter
- {泣|な}き{笑|わら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to end up laughing and crying

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き→嬉し泣き：19040_ureshinaki⟧ - tears of joy
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧ - tears and smiles
